note: Section 1 (battles) of the Angel cluster. Q001 is the closed roster of every battle the Angel is in; the 49 fact questions cover the three fight beats drawn from the History, Culling Game Arc and Shinjuku Showdown Arc sections plus the Overall Abilities / Personality read-acrosses. Golds are NFKD-verbatim on the Angel page and present in the live bundle; the closed battle set is declared in _jjk_page_angel.decl1.yaml (staged, G6).

retired.question: Where did the Desshi Pacification Squad fight Sukuna?
retired.reason: Not stated on the page: the History section dates the fight only to the Heian Era a thousand years ago and names no place.

retired.question: In which episode is the Culling Game fight with Sukuna depicted?
retired.reason: Not stated on the page: the Angel page cites manga chapters only ({{Ref|chap=...}}) and carries no episode locator in its prose, so no episode gold can be verbatim on the page.

retired.question: Which other Culling Game players did Angel fight in the Culling Game?
retired.reason: Not a closed set on the page: the only Culling Game fight recorded is the rooftop fight with Sukuna (ids 020-030); Megumi's sister (id 019) reveals herself and flies away without a fight, and no list of other players Angel fought is given.

retired.question: How did Angel defeat Sukuna?
retired.reason: No such defeat is stated: the Culling Game fight ended in Hana's defeat by Sukuna (id 027) and the Heian Era attack was repelled (id 005); the page records no Angel victory over Sukuna.

retired.question: What did Angel do to Sukuna in the Heian Era?
retired.reason: Not stated on the page: the History section states only that the squad was repelled by the King of Curses wielding his two weapons (ids 005-006) and describes no Angel action on Sukuna in that fight.
